name: Oazuke Fetish!
original_name: おあずけフェティッシュ！
source:
One year, on the 14th of February, the protagonist has gone from being a dull virgin to a fiercely popular guy, but because of a minor secret about his pubic area (which would be embarrassing if exposed), he can't have an intimate relationship with a girl even if he wanted to.

Then a magical girl who claims to be the "Goddess of Hair" appears and offers to perform a ritual that will solve his problems in one fell swoop. The protagonist agrees to the offer, but for some reason the only condition for success is that he has to spend one more month without letting anyone know the secret of his small genitals.

In other words, until the 14th of March, when the ritual is to be carried out, he has to live a pure and innocent school life without revealing the contents of his pants to the heroines.
Will the protagonist, who is exposed to unrelenting pheromones and must never surrender to the flow, be able to survive these heavenly hellish days? 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=488505]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
某一年，2月14日，主角从一个木讷的处女变成了一个炙手可热的大帅哥，却因为自己的阴部的一个小秘密（暴露了就尴尬了），让他即使想和女孩发生亲密关系也做不到。

这时，一位自称“头发女神”的魔法少女出现，并主动提出举行仪式，一举解决他的问题。主角同意了这个提议，但由于某种原因，成功的唯一条件是他必须再花一个月的时间，不能让任何人知道他小生殖器的秘密。

也就是说，在3月14日举行仪式之前，他必须过着纯洁无邪的学校生活，不能向女主角透露裤子里的东西。
暴露在无情的信息素之下、绝不能屈服的主角能否度过这天堂地狱般的日子呢？
